notes: Markers: "|" separates alternative substrings (outcomes). Strings are copied from G.State.log calls unless tagged [UI-only].

News items with history:true are NOT journaled by default; they reach the journal only via Journal.SOURCES wraps (journal.js:190-215: Rel, Dominion, Treaty, Barb, Tudor, Aztec, IncaFall, GoaMal, Mina, MingFall, Westphalia, Nzinga, Potosi, RomeSack, GalPisa, Imjin, Globe, Succession, Disaster, Econ, Era) or explicit G.State.log. Journal text = raw (【title】 → "title — "); window text = UI.tidyNews (header dropped, " — " → ", ").
Journal is capped at 800 lines (journal.js J.trim); trimmed lines move to s.logArc.old (logbooks.js) — grep both.
Declines that log nothing: skylore offers, glory calls, gyeonwoo offer, quixote meet, snowqueen refusal → "declined" is indistinguishable from "never met" in the journal.
